brief:
Kosovo agreed to contribute troops to a US-led stabilization force for Gaza, according to Al Jazeera English. The Balkan state became one of a handful of nations to commit peacekeepers to the Palestinian enclave, joining a select group of countries backing the American initiative.

The deployment marks a significant step in assembling an international coalition for post-conflict operations in Gaza. Kosovo's participation adds to growing momentum for the US-sponsored effort, though few countries have publicly committed forces to the mission so far.

Details of Kosovo's troop numbers, deployment timeline, and specific operational roles have not been announced. The commitment reflects broader diplomatic efforts to establish security arrangements for the territory as international attention focuses on stabilization efforts in the region.
dek: Balkan state joins short list of countries agreeing to send peacekeepers to Palestinian enclave.
title: Kosovo joins US-led peacekeeping mission to Gaza
